summary: Master the art of selling to C-Suite executives. Learn ROI modeling, stakeholder mapping, and strategic value positioning to close large enterprise deals.
lede: C-level selling training helps experienced sales professionals prepare business-focused conversations with senior decision makers. It covers mapping stakeholders, connecting solutions to business priorities, building ROI cases, and creating concise executive briefings. Learners also practice strategic account planning and value-based negotiation for complex sales involving multiple decision makers.
audienceIntro: This program is curated for experienced sales professionals who operate in high-stakes, multi-layered environments where senior-level buy-in is the primary driver of success.
audience: Client Success Directors focused on executive-level expansion
modules: The Executive Mindset and Decision Architecture
Decoding Corporate Strategy through Financial Analysis
Navigating the Power Base and Stakeholder Mapping
AI and Digital Intelligence in Executive Sales
ESG, Sustainability, and the Modern Decision Framework
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 5 years of experience in B2B sales or account management. Familiarity with basic financial concepts (Revenue, COGS, EBITDA) is required. It is highly recommended that participants bring a real-world enterprise account they are currently targeting to use during the practical exercises.
